overall: The AG found the Arlington School Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by creating insufficiently accurate minutes of its May 1, 2025 executive session, and the June 2026 amendment did not cure the defect.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the May 1, 2025 executive session minutes on a contract renewal lacked the accuracy and level of detail the Open Meeting Law requires.
allegations.key_passage: Thus, we find that the original minutes fall short of the accuracy requirement in the Open Meeting Law, and that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to create and approve sufficiently accurate minutes.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Within 30 days of the letter, revise the May 1, 2025 executive session minutes to the best of the Committee's ability with available information, and notify the AG's office that it has done so.
remedy_passage: We order the Committee’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and we caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law. In addition, we order the Committee, within 30 days of the date of this letter, to revise the minutes of the May 1, 2025, executive session to the best of its ability, with the information available to them, and to notify our office that it has done so.
